program.name: Hartland Esports
program.heroText: Varsity and JV teams from Hartland High School, competing in the Michigan High School Esports League and on the national stage in the USAEL Open.
program.aboutText: Hartland Esports gives students a team to belong to, coaches who push them, and a real path to compete for state and national titles. Players practice together in the High School Esports Lab, compete against schools across Michigan, and represent the Eagles every match day.
program.lab: Hartland High School Esports Lab, just inside the High School Media Center
program.teamsIntro: Our varsity and JV teams compete in the Michigan High School Esports League, with Fortnite Varsity #1 also competing nationally in the USAEL Open.

seasons.name: Fall season
seasons.text: Our main season. Teams compete weekly, building to the Fall State Championship on the first weekend of December.

seasons.name: Practices & walk-ons
seasons.text: Practices pick back up, with a brief walk-on period for new players.

seasons.name: Winter/Spring season
seasons.text: Our highly competitive season. We select our top teams, often combining rosters, for one last push. Winning state qualifies a team for the national stage, and spring is the last chance to earn it if we didn't in the fall.

tryouts.title: Fall 2026 tryouts
tryouts.location: Hartland High School Esports Lab (inside the High School Media Center)
tryouts.text: Tryouts are held at the start of the school year, with a short walk-on period in late January before the Winter/Spring season.

news.summary: State runner-up in its first-ever season. Hartland's Rocket League team beat perennial powers Divine Child and Detroit Catholic Central to reach the Fall 2023 MHSEL title match at Oakland University, and its players drew interest from college programs.
news.title: Hartland E-Sports Team Competes In Semi-Finals In First Season

news.summary: The U.S. Army's esports trailer rolled into Hartland High School, joined by players from Eastern Michigan and Oakland University. Coach Cameron Montney highlighted what the program offers beyond gameplay: teamwork, college scholarships, and student-run streaming, shoutcasting, and graphic design.
news.title: Army's Esports Semi to Visit Hartland High School

news.summary: State champions. The #3 seed Hartland Eagles won the Fall 2024 Rocket League state title at Michigan State, erasing a 3-1 deficit to beat undefeated #1 Rochester in Game 7 and earning a bid to the 2025 PlayVS Cup.
news.title: Hartland High School Esports Team Wins State Championship
Hartland Eagles Soar at First MEC x SMC Fiber Cup
news.summary: In their first year as a club, the Hartland Eagles traveled across the state and won the inaugural MEC x SMC Fiber Cup, topping a 15-team Rocket League field at Southwestern Michigan College in the team's first live-audience event.

news.title: Hartland Esports Sends Teams to 2025 State Championship LAN
news.summary: Two Hartland teams reached the MHSEL Elite Eight in Fall 2025. Super Smash Bros. edged Belleville 3-2, and a freshman Fortnite duo swept Melvindale, sending both to the State Championship LAN at Michigan State. Elka Borreson and Jeffery Howe earned All-State honors.

news.title: Signed, Sealed, Delivered, Hartland Back on Top
news.summary: State champions again. Dylan "Qyxical" Reinwand and Tavin "TRE4TY" Flanagan won the MiHSEF Spring 2026 Rocket League title at UM-Flint, beating Godwin Heights 4-2. The turning point was Flanagan's goal-line save and coast-to-coast overtime winner in Game 5.

news.title: Hartland Rocket League Star Dylan Reinwand Signs with Cleary University
news.summary: Senior Dylan "Qyxical" Reinwand has signed with Cleary University. The Fall 2024 state champion and All-State selection also led Hartland to a Top 5 finish at the PlayVS Cup nationals.

State champions. The #3 seed Hartland Eagles won the program's first MHSEL Rocket League title at Michigan State, erasing a 3-1 deficit to beat undefeated #1 Rochester in Game 7 and earning a bid to the 2025 PlayVS Cup.
news.title: Hartland Esports Captures Fall 2024 Rocket League State Championship in Thrilling Fashion
Eagles Soar to National Elite Eight in 2025 PlayVS Cup
news.summary: Top 5 in the nation. Hartland's Rocket League team beat teams from Massachusetts and Arkansas to reach the Elite Eight of the 2025 PlayVS Cup and placed Top 5 in the final national rankings, out of more than 1,100 teams.

records.title: State Champions
records.detail: The #3 seed Eagles won the program's first state title, erasing a 3-1 deficit to beat undefeated #1 Rochester in Game 7 at Michigan State.

records.title: State Champions
records.detail: Dylan "Qyxical" Reinwand and Tavin "TRE4TY" Flanagan won the MiHSEF Spring 2026 Rocket League State Championship at UM-Flint, beating Godwin Heights 4-2 after going 9-0 in group play (56-8 in goals) to earn the #1 seed. Flanagan's goal-line save and coast-to-coast overtime winner in Game 5 swung the final.

records.title: Fiber Cup Champions
records.detail: Kyle Greig, Lincoln Deman, and Christian Gatien won the inaugural 15-team tournament at Southwestern Michigan College, the program's first trophy and first live-audience event.

records.title: State Runner-Up
records.detail: In the program's first-ever season, Hartland beat Divine Child and Detroit Catholic Central before falling to Linden in the final at Oakland University.
Hartland reached the Elite Eight of the PlayVS Cup and finished Top 5 in the final national rankings, out of more than 1,100 teams.

roadmap.title: Approval queue and student submission inbox
roadmap.text: Students submit clips and bio drafts; everything lands in one queue for the coach to approve, and students never edit live pages. Build a single reusable queue, shared with the social graphics approval.

roadmap.title: Milestone announcements
roadmap.text: 100th career goal, the program's 50th win and similar milestones, announced with the same splash and ticker system as broken records.

roadmap.title: Replayable announcement feed
roadmap.text: A log of every announcement event so mid-match corrections can be reconciled without announcing twice.

roadmap.title: Auto social graphic for broken records
roadmap.text: A ready-to-post graphic when a record falls. Ties into the Canva Autofill + Buffer feature.

roadmap.title: Rank by API
roadmap.text: Pull ranks automatically if a free Rocket League rank API ever exists. Until then ranks are typed in by hand on each profile.

roadmap.title: Rocket League stats straight from the game
roadmap.status: Moved from a build (needs something we don't have yet)
roadmap.text: Moved from "record-breaking announcements". The Rocket League game feed (Stats API) only reaches the stream overlay on the game PC; it has no signed-in path to save goals, saves and shots into the scorekeeper, so Rocket League records are still checked when those stats are typed in. Needs a small signed-in helper on the game PC (or a scorekeeper screen that listens to the game) to log stats on its own.

roadmap.title: Per-game Rocket League leaders
roadmap.status: Moved from a build (needs something we don't have yet)
roadmap.text: Moved from "launch records". Most Rocket League history was logged as match totals, not game by game, so single-game leaders can't be worked out fairly yet. The record book has single-match leaders now; per-game boards can be added once a season of game-by-game stats is logged.
